notes.title: New FPS Mode (Update v.0.9.2)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35186080/91ddfdf0127cc5fffd2fe2e2a496127904ca2b8e.png
Hello Everyone,

DestructoPod contains a new FPS mode. Players can now perform battle from the ground. Run the course for a completely different experience. Jump over structures with controllable hang time.

The controller aim stick has been converted in to a strafing stick. Strafing the pod to the side helps avoid incoming projectiles and helps lay down attack fire. Cut towers in half with ease. 

Spent the last month optimizing all the systems and found some areas that could be greatly improved. DestructoPod runs a lot faster now. I'm starting to think about porting to handheld devices.

I’ve also been polishing the game with new textures and a new arena. 

Thanks for your feedback and support.

Cheers,
Helmar

notes.title: Full Auto (Update v.0.9.1)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35186080/df1b95c6d2e12bebb615477b3c7107597efad549.png

Hi Everyone,
DestructoPod has gone full auto rapid fire. No more single shot per click required. Hold down the fire button and blaze away.

The pod requires fast steering to avoid obstacles and enemy fire, but it also needs finer aiming controls to take out targets as well. Using the mouse to fly and aim is easy, but terrible for hard turns. Especially if you wish to do a U-turn. For this, use the ‘A’ and ‘D’ keys to perform hard left and right turns. This setup works well (at least for me) for very fast and accurate game play.

Controllers are a different story. Putting both these qualities in a single controller stick that has only about an inch of movement is problematic. So I opted to use both controller sticks for steering. One stick for faster flight steering and the other for slower finer aiming control. 

The pod coasting speed has increased. It is set to coast just fast enough to where the course can still be flown with only the aim control. 

Thanks for your support.

Cheers,
Helmar

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The Star Wars trench run was a big inspiration behind DestructoPod. I wanted to create a game that encapsulated the excitement I felt when I saw the X-wing fighters scream down the Death Star’s trench avoiding blasters. I than augmented the idea with twisty canyons and other obstacles to make the game more challenging. But I’m realizing flying is not for everyone. In fact, flying in narrow corridors can be actually quite challenging. So I’m considering adding a FPS mode that is similar to how the “Mindless Mayhem” level is played. Players could than run the course instead of fly it. All other aspects of the game would remain the same.

The controller remains my biggest Achilles heel. I’ve always used the keyboard/mouse to play games and avoided controllers. I’m simply bad at using them. I figure if I can get it to the point where I can fly it well using a controller, everyone else should have no problem with it. So enter the “Duke” and some controller modifications. I should have the update ready by the end of the week.

Ideas, thoughts and suggestions are always welcome.
Thanks for your support.

Cheers,
Helmar
